name: Animated Button
description: High-performance interactive motion button featuring tactile spring scaling, optional continuous shimmer beam, and polymorphic loading/icon slots.

code.readme:
# Animated Button

A tactile, spring-physics button built with Motion and Tailwind CSS. Supports micro-interactions, continuous shimmer sweeps, fluid loading states, and customizable icon placements.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
```

## Usage

```tsx
import { AnimatedButton } from '@/components/ui/animated-button';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AnimatedButton variant="emerald" shimmer icon={ArrowRight}>
      Get Started
    </AnimatedButton>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `variant` | `'emerald' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost'` | `'emerald'` | Visual styling mode |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Button height and padding scale |
| `icon` | `LucideIcon` | `undefined` | Lucide icon component reference |
| `iconPosition` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'right'` | Side to render the icon |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays spinning indicator and disables interactions |
| `shimmer` | `boolean` | `false` | Enables looping light reflection gradient sweep |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | HTML button disabled state |

name: Magnetic Button
description: Interactive button that physically gravitates toward the cursor using spring physics and relative cursor bounding box calculations.

code.readme:
# Magnetic Button

A magnetic action button that pulls toward the mouse cursor when hovering within its bounds using spring physics.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add motion clsx tailwind-merge
```

## Usage

```tsx
import { MagneticButton } from '@/components/ui/magnetic-button';
import { Compass } from 'lucide-react';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <MagneticButton variant="emerald" magneticStrength={0.4}>
      <Compass className="h-4 w-4" />
      Attract Cursor
    </MagneticButton>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `magneticStrength` | `number` | `0.35` | Multiplier for cursor pull distance (0.1 to 0.6) |
| `variant` | `'emerald' \| 'outline' \| 'slate'` | `'emerald'` | Button color scheme |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Button label and icons |

# Shimmer Button

A smooth conic-gradient border shimmer button tailored for high-end dark interfaces.

import { ShimmerButton } from '@/components/ui/shimmer-button';

    <ShimmerButton shimmerColor="#10b981">

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `shimmerDuration` | `string` | `'2.5s'` | Cycle rotation period duration |
| `borderRadius` | `string` | `'100px'` | CSS border radius |
| `background` | `string` | `'rgba(11, 15, 25, 1)'` | Interior container color |
